sentences.text: Malaysia -LRB- -LSB- məˈleɪsiə -RSB- ; -LSB- məlejsiə -RSB- -RRB- is a federal constitutional monarchy located in Southeast Asia .	constitutional monarchy	constitutional monarchy	federal	federation	Southeast Asia	Southeast Asia

It consists of thirteen states and three federal territories and has a total landmass of 330803 km2 separated by the South China Sea into two similarly sized regions , Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia -LRB- Malaysian Borneo -RRB- .	Malaysian	Malaysians	federal	federation	thirteen states and three federal territories	States and federal territories of Malaysia	South China Sea	South China Sea	Peninsular Malaysia	Peninsular Malaysia	East Malaysia	East Malaysia

Peninsular Malaysia shares a land and maritime border with Thailand and maritime borders with Singapore , Vietnam , and Indonesia .	Singapore	Singapore	Peninsular Malaysia	Peninsular Malaysia	Thailand	Thailand	Vietnam	Vietnam	Indonesia	Indonesia

East Malaysia shares land and maritime borders with Brunei and Indonesia and a maritime border with the Philippines and Vietnam .	East Malaysia	East Malaysia	Vietnam	Vietnam	Indonesia	Indonesia	Brunei	Brunei	Philippines	Philippines
The capital city is Kuala Lumpur , while Putrajaya is the seat of the federal government .	Kuala Lumpur	Kuala Lumpur	Putrajaya	Putrajaya	federal	federation
With a population of over 30 million , Malaysia is the 44th most populous country .	44th most populous country	List of countries by population
The southernmost point of continental Eurasia , Tanjung Piai , is in Malaysia .	Eurasia	Eurasia	Tanjung Piai	Tanjung Piai

Located in the tropics , Malaysia is one of 17 megadiverse countries on earth , with large numbers of endemic species .	tropics	tropics	megadiverse countries	megadiverse countries	endemic species	Wildlife of Malaysia
Malaysia has its origins in the Malay kingdoms present in the area which , from the 18th century , became subject to the British Empire .	Malay	Malaysian Malay	British Empire	British Empire

The first British territories were known as the Straits Settlements , whose establishment was followed by the Malay kingdoms becoming British protectorates .	Malay	Malaysian Malay	Straits Settlements	Straits Settlements
The territories on Peninsular Malaysia were first unified as the Malayan Union in 1946 .	Peninsular Malaysia	Peninsular Malaysia	Malayan Union	Malayan Union
Malaya was restructured as the Federation of Malaya in 1948 , and achieved independence on 31 August 1957 .	Federation of Malaya	Federation of Malaya
Malaya united with North Borneo , Sarawak , and Singapore on 16 September 1963 to become Malaysia .	Singapore	Singapore	North Borneo	Crown Colony of North Borneo	Sarawak	Crown Colony of Sarawak
Less than two years later in 1965 , Singapore was expelled from the federation .	Singapore	Singapore
The country is multi-ethnic and multi-cultural , which plays a large role in politics .	multi-ethnic	Ethnic groups in Malaysia	multi-cultural	Culture of Malaysia

About half the population is ethnically Malay , with large minorities of Malaysian Chinese , Malaysian Indians , and indigenous peoples .	Malay	Malaysian Malay	Chinese	Malaysian Chinese	Malaysian	Malaysians	Malaysian Chinese	Malaysian Chinese	indigenous peoples	Orang Asal

The constitution declares Islam the state religion while allowing freedom of religion for non-Muslims .	constitution	Constitution of Malaysia	Islam	Islam in Malaysia	state religion	state religion	freedom of religion	freedom of religion

The government system is closely modelled on the Westminster parliamentary system and the legal system is based on common law .	parliamentary	parliamentary system	Westminster parliamentary system	Westminster system	common law	common law
The head of state is the king , known as the Yang di-Pertuan Agong .	Yang di-Pertuan Agong	Yang di-Pertuan Agong	head of state	head of state

He is an elected monarch chosen from the hereditary rulers of the nine Malay states every five years .	Malay	Malaysian Malay	elected monarch	Elective monarchy	rulers	Monarchies of Malaysia	Malay states	Malay states
The head of government is the prime minister .	prime minister	Prime Minister of Malaysia
Since its independence , Malaysia has had one of the best economic records in Asia , with its GDP growing at an average of 6.5 % per annum for almost 50 years .	GDP	Gross domestic product
The economy has traditionally been fuelled by its natural resources , but is expanding in the sectors of science , tourism , commerce and medical tourism .	medical tourism	Medical tourism in Malaysia

Today , Malaysia has a newly industrialised market economy , ranked third largest in Southeast Asia and 29th largest in the world .	Southeast Asia	Southeast Asia	newly industrialised	newly industrialised country	market economy	market economy	29th largest in the world	List of countries by GDP (PPP)
